# eatPrepTBA

The goal of eatPrepTBA is to provide wrapper functions to interact with
the IQB Studio and the IQB Testcenter APIs. Moreover, it provides some
routines for preparing and blending data from these different resources
to manage TBA studies.

## Package governance

This package was originally authored and created by Philipp Franikowski.
**Current package maintenance** is provided by Karoline A. Sachse,
Kristoph Schumann, and Jakob Schaefer.

## Installation

You can install the development version of eatPrepTBA from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("iqb-research/eatPrepTBA")
```

# Package index

## Connecting to the API

Functions and classes for communicating with the IQB Testcenter API

### Functions for access

- [`login_studio()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/login_studio.md)
  : Generate a LoginStudio object for the IQB Studio Lite
- [`login_testcenter()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/login_testcenter.md)
  : Generate a LoginTestcenter object for the IQB Testcenter
- [`access_workspace()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/access_workspace.md)
  : Access a workspace

### Classes

- [`Login-class`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/Login-class.md)
  : Login credentials
- [`LoginStudio-class`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/LoginStudio-class.md)
  : Login credentials for IQB Studio
- [`LoginTestcenter-class`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/LoginTestcenter-class.md)
  : Login credentials for IQB Testcenter
- [`Workspace-class`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/Workspace-class.md)
  : Workspace access
- [`WorkspaceStudio-class`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/WorkspaceStudio-class.md)
  : Workspace access for IQB Studio
- [`WorkspaceTestcenter-class`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/WorkspaceTestcenter-class.md)
  : Workspace access for IQB Testcenter

## Preparing unit metadata and coding schemes

Functions to prepare unit data from IQB Studio or Testcenter

### List resources on IQB Studio

- [`list_units()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/list_units.md)
  : List unit files
- [`list_groups()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/list_groups.md)
  : List groups

### List resources on IQB Testcenter

- [`list_files()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/list_files.md)
  : List files
- [`list_resources()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/list_resources.md)
  : List unit resource files
- [`list_units()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/list_units.md)
  : List unit files
- [`list_booklets()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/list_booklets.md)
  : List booklet files
- [`list_testtakers()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/list_testtakers.md)
  : List testtakers files
- [`list_system_checks()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/list_system_checks.md)
  : List system check files

### Handle units and workspaces on IQB Studio

- [`get_units()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/get_units.md)
  : Get multiple units with resources

### Retrieve responses from IQB Testcenter

- [`download_responses()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/download_responses.md)
  : Downloads responses directly from Testcenter
- [`get_responses()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/get_responses.md)
  : Get responses directly from Testcenter
- [`read_responses()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/read_responses.md)
  : Reads responses files
- [`prepare_responses()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/prepare_responses.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Prepares responses
- [`get_system_checks()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/get_system_checks.md)
  : Get system check reports
- [`read_system_checks()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/read_system_checks.md)
  : Reads and prepares system check file
- [`get_design()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/get_design.md)
  : Recovers a design from IQB Testcenter
- [`get_booklets()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/get_booklets.md)
  : Get a booklets from IQB Testcenter
- [`read_booklet()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/read_booklet.md)
  : Reads a booklet XML
- [`get_testtakers()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/get_testtakers.md)
  : Get a testtakers from IQB Testcenter
- [`read_testtakers()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/read_testtakers.md)
  : Reads a testtakers XML
- [`get_results()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/get_results.md)
  : Get results
- [`get_logs()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/get_logs.md)
  : Get logs
- [`read_logs()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/read_logs.md)
  : Reads log files
- [`prepare_logs()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/prepare_logs.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Prepares logs
- [`get_reviews()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/get_reviews.md)
  : Get reviews
- [`compute_sizes()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/compute_sizes.md)
  : Computes resource sizes for Testcenter instances
- [`prepare_coded()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/prepare_coded.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Prepares codes

### Functions for units

- [`add_metadata()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/add_metadata.md)
  : Add metadata to units
- [`add_coding_scheme()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/add_coding_scheme.md)
  : Adds prepared coding scheme to units
- [`extract_metadata()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/extract_metadata.md)
  : Extract metadata profiles from units with metadata

## Managing studies

Functions to check units, prepare material for administration and coding

### Prepare studies on IQB Studio

- [`get_units()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/get_units.md)
  : Get multiple units with resources
- [`get_states()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/get_states.md)
  : Get states
- [`get_settings()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/get_settings.md)
  : Get workspace settings
- [`get_coding_report()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/get_coding_report.md)
  : Get coding report
- [`prepare_coding_scheme()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/prepare_coding_scheme.md)
  : Prepares a readable version of a coding scheme of one unit
- [`download_codebook()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/download_codebook.md)
  : Download codebook
- [`prepare_codebook()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/prepare_codebook.md)
  : Prepares a rectangular codebook
- [`download_units()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/download_units.md)
  : Download units
- [`add_groups()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/add_groups.md)
  : Add workspace groups for a Studio workspace
- [`test_coding_scheme()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/test_coding_scheme.md)
  : Test Coding Scheme

### Prepare studies on IQB Testcenter

- [`generate_testtakers()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/generate_testtakers.md)
  : Generate Testcenter testtakers XML
- [`generate_booklet()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/generate_booklet.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Generates booklets XML from unit information
- [`generate_booklets()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/generate_booklets.md)
  : Generates booklet XMLs from booklet, testlet, and unit information
- [`prepare_booklets_from_block_design()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/prepare_booklets_from_block_design.md)
  : Prepare booklet specifications from a tabular block design
- [`upload_file()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/upload_file.md)
  : Upload file

### Analyse Testcenter log data

- [`summarise_log_inventory()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/summarise_log_inventory.md)
  : Summarise log event types
- [`summarise_log_environment()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/summarise_log_environment.md)
  : Summarise LOADCOMPLETE environment logs
- [`detect_log_anomalies()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/detect_log_anomalies.md)
  : Detect potentially unreliable log patterns
- [`summarise_log_qc()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/summarise_log_qc.md)
  : Summarise log quality anomalies by session
- [`summarise_log_connections()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/summarise_log_connections.md)
  : Summarise connection state logs
- [`summarise_log_focus()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/summarise_log_focus.md)
  : Summarise focus state logs
- [`summarise_log_player()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/summarise_log_player.md)
  : Summarise player state logs
- [`summarise_log_pages()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/summarise_log_pages.md)
  : Summarise page state logs
- [`summarise_log_progress()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/summarise_log_progress.md)
  : Summarise response and presentation progress logs
- [`add_unit_sizes()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/add_unit_sizes.md)
  : Add unit resource sizes to log-derived unit data
- [`summarise_system_checks()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/summarise_system_checks.md)
  : Summarise system check data
- [`add_system_check_summary()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/add_system_check_summary.md)
  : Add system check summaries to log-derived data

### Code responses and work with coded responses and logs from IQB Testcenter

- [`code_responses()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/code_responses.md)
  : Code unit responses with coding schemes
- [`unpack_response_jsons()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/unpack_response_jsons.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Unpack response JSON columns
- [`prepare_unpacked_codes()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/prepare_unpacked_codes.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Prepare unpacked response codes
- [`complete_design()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/complete_design.md)
  : Complete design with coded responses
- [`estimate_unit_times()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/estimate_unit_times.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Estimates loading and stay times for units,
  unit plays and pages from log data
- [`estimate_audio_video_plays()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/estimate_audio_video_plays.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Estimate audio and video play counts from
  response JSONs
- [`evaluate_psychometrics()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/evaluate_psychometrics.md)
  : Evaluates frequencies and discrimination parameters of codes and
  categories
- [`compute_staytime_tables()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/compute_staytime_tables.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Computes quantile tables of stay times
- [`layout_staytime_tables()`](https://iqb-research.github.io/eatPrepTBA/reference/layout_staytime_tables.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Sets and layouts quantile tables of stay times
